title.zh-CN: 头伤后再次意识丧失和抽搐 · 16岁男性
title.en: Recurrent unconsciousness and seizures after head injury · 16-year-old male

summary.zh-CN: 围绕头伤后再次意识丧失和抽搐，比较现有证据、不同解释与下一步处理。
summary.en: Review the evidence, competing explanations and next steps for recurrent unconsciousness and seizures after head injury.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别迟发再出血的血管警示。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise vascular warning signs in delayed rebleeding.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释 MRI 与阴性 DSA 不一致。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain discordance between MRI and negative DSA.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 提出紧急神经血管团队处理。
区分病理确诊与医源性因果推论。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish pathological confirmation from iatrogenic causal inference.

finding.en: Initially there was left parieto-occipital scalp swelling and meningism.

text.zh-CN: 起初桥前及后颅窝 SAH，无颅骨骨折；第 10 天吸收，但第 29 天再出血并入脑室，延髓左侧高密度。
text.en: Initial prepontine/posterior-fossa SAH without skull fracture; apparent absorption at day ten, then recurrent haemorrhage with intraventricular extension and left medullary hyperdensity at day 29.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 延髓左侧圆形含血栓样信号占位，考虑假性动脉瘤。
text.en: A rounded left-medullary lesion with thrombus-like signal, suspicious for pseudoaneurysm.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 均未显影动脉瘤，但左 PICA 呈抱球样改变。
text.en: Neither demonstrated aneurysm filling, but left PICA curved around the lesion.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 探查发现左 PICA 分支假性动脉瘤并夹闭，病理证实。术后恢复意识，短暂吞咽反射减弱及饮水呛咳约 2 周恢复；DSA 示 PICA 局部轻度狭窄、远端通畅。
text.en: Exploration found a left PICA-branch pseudoaneurysm, which was clipped and confirmed pathologically. Awareness returned; temporary gag/swallow dysfunction resolved over about two weeks. DSA showed mild focal PICA narrowing with patent distal flow.

hint.zh-CN: 从起病、演变及伴随症状寻找关键信息。
hint.en: Clarify onset, progression and associated symptoms.

hint.zh-CN: 区分患者叙述、查体记录和辅助检查报告。
hint.en: Distinguish the history, examination record and investigation reports.

hint.zh-CN: 指出支持证据、反证和仍需核对的信息。
hint.en: Identify supporting evidence, conflicting evidence and remaining gaps.

hint.zh-CN: 将报告结局与当时可获得的证据分开。
hint.en: Separate the reported outcome from evidence available at the decision point.

prompt.zh-CN: 阴性造影后应怎样调整判断？
prompt.en: How should negative angiography affect suspicion?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 仍高度疑似被血栓遮蔽的创伤性血管病变
text.en: A thrombosed traumatic vascular lesion remains strongly suspected

feedback.zh-CN: 再出血和 MRI 与阴性充盈可共存。
feedback.en: Rebleeding and MRI suspicion can coexist with absent angiographic filling.

text.zh-CN: DSA 阴性绝对排除动脉瘤
text.en: Negative DSA absolutely excludes aneurysm

feedback.zh-CN: 完全或部分血栓可使病变不显影。

text.zh-CN: 无骨折就不可能有血管损伤
text.en: No fracture means no vascular injury

feedback.zh-CN: 闭合伤也可造成血管病变。
feedback.en: Closed trauma can still injure vessels.

prompt.en: What is the appropriate pathway now?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 立即神经外科/血管团队评估减压与病灶处理，不机械等待阳性造影
text.en: Immediate neurosurgical/vascular assessment of decompression and lesion treatment without mechanically awaiting positive angiography

feedback.zh-CN: 急变且后颅窝再出血危及脑干。
feedback.en: Deterioration with posterior-fossa rebleeding threatens the brainstem.

text.zh-CN: 继续反复大量腰穿作为唯一处理
text.en: Continue repeated large lumbar drainage as sole treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 不能替代血管病变与颅压安全评估。
feedback.en: This cannot replace vascular and intracranial-pressure assessment.

text.zh-CN: 按既往 CT 吸收安排普通随访
text.en: Use the old improving CT to arrange routine follow-up

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 手术及病理确证假性动脉瘤，但不能证明每次引流造成再出血
text.en: Surgery/pathology confirm pseudoaneurysm, not that each drainage caused rebleeding

feedback.zh-CN: 医源性贡献在原文仅被反思。
feedback.en: Iatrogenic contribution is discussed as a concern, not proven.

text.zh-CN: 已证明腰穿是唯一病因
text.en: Lumbar puncture is proven the sole cause

feedback.zh-CN: 缺少因果对照且原有外伤。
feedback.en: There is no causal comparison and trauma preceded it.

text.zh-CN: 载瘤动脉轻度狭窄无需记录
text.en: Mild parent-vessel narrowing can be omitted

feedback.zh-CN: 这关系到术后灌注与随访。
feedback.en: It matters for perfusion and follow-up.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 迟发后颅窝再出血源于创伤性 PICA 假性动脉瘤；阴性充盈影像不能凌驾于临床与 MRI 证据。
conclusion.en: Delayed posterior-fossa rebleeding arose from a traumatic PICA pseudoaneurysm; absent angiographic filling did not outweigh the clinical/MRI evidence.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 后颅窝 SAH 与反复新鲜血性脑脊液应警惕血管来源。
keyReasoning.en: Posterior-fossa SAH and fresh recurrent bloody CSF warrant vascular suspicion.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血栓可改变造影可见性。
历史有风险操作不能被参考路径重复执行。
keyReasoning.en: Historical risky procedures should not be reenacted by the reference path.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.

unknowns.zh-CN: 伤前血管影像、最早血管病变状态及引流的独立因果作用未知。
unknowns.en: Pre-injury vascular imaging, earliest lesion state and independent causal effect of drainage are unknown.
